title: StakeholderAnalysisInput
description: Input for stakeholder analysis of a meeting transcript. Supports two modes: transcript-only (broad stakeholder scan) or transcript + additional context (targeted analysis with known stakeholders, a focal decision, and organizational background). All optional fields improve analysis quality when provided.

transcript.description: Full meeting transcript text. Must include enough content for meaningful stakeholder analysis (minimum 80 characters). Speaker-attributed transcripts produce higher-confidence output.
examples: Alice Chen: Let's discuss the platform migration timeline. Bob Park: I think Q3 is realistic if we get buy-in from infrastructure...

analysis_goal.description: The purpose of this stakeholder analysis. Adjusts depth, framing, and emphasis of the output. Example: 'prep for exec review', 'identify blockers before launch', 'map decision-makers for budget approval'.

focal_decision.description: A specific decision or proposal the analysis should center on. When provided, stakeholder stances, risks, and engagement plans are evaluated relative to this decision. Example: 'ship v1 in Q2', 'migrate to microservices', 'expand into APAC'.

org_context.description: Organizational background that helps interpret transcript dynamics: company stage, culture, recent changes, political landscape. Example: 'Post-acquisition integration; two engineering orgs merging, competing roadmaps.'
examples: Series B SaaS, 200 employees, recently hired new CTO from enterprise background

stakeholder_directory.description: Pre-known stakeholders to seed the analysis. The analyzer will still discover additional stakeholders from the transcript. Each entry provides name, role, team, and an optional power hint.

name.description: Full name of the stakeholder as they appear in the transcript.

role.description: Job title or organizational role. Example: 'VP Engineering', 'Product Lead'.

team.description: Team, department, or business unit. Example: 'Platform', 'Product', 'Finance'.

power_hint.description: Optional hint about this person's organizational power level. Helps calibrate influence analysis when transcript evidence alone is insufficient.

key_questions.description: Specific questions the analysis should address. Each should be a concrete concern about stakeholder dynamics. Example items: 'Who has veto power over the budget?', 'Is the infrastructure team aligned with the timeline?'
examples: Who has veto power over the budget?
Is the infrastructure team aligned with the timeline?

time_horizon.description: Time frame for the analysis. Affects urgency of engagement plans and risk assessment. 'immediate' = this week. '30d' = next month. 'quarter' = this quarter. '6-12m' = multi-quarter strategic horizon.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum confidence level for including a stakeholder finding. 0.0 = include everything (even speculative). 1.0 = only include findings with strong transcript evidence. Default behavior if omitted: 0.5.
